blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. said Friday that he would summon Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan over the envoy’s remarks that China could easily win if it chose to use force. “I think that deserves a discussion between the ambassador and myself,” Marcos said in an ambush interview. READ: China can ‘easily win’ using force, but wants peace, says envoy to PH “Well, it sounds very much to me like a threat, and it is not a very diplomatic statement to make. So, we perhaps would like to understand what exactly it is that he means,” he added. /jpv... Keep on reading: Marcos to summon Chinese envoy over ‘threatening’ remarks
